research_scope: Five early/base-game skills from PQ19-PQ23 selected after live repository duplicate checks. Quest identity and core mechanics are corroborated; unsupported reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish requirements remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose E
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force
records.skill_description: A temporary pose that boosts normal/basic attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: Skill-specific data identifies Fighting Pose E as a Power Up Super using 0 Ki, lasting 20 seconds and temporarily boosting normal/basic attack. PQ19 reward listings independently identify the skill. Historical player reports discuss random acquisition but do not establish a canonical drop condition.

records.name: Mystic Flash
records.skill_description: A rear-facing Ki Wave Ultimate that hits repeatedly and knocks the opponent back.
records.mechanics_notes: Skill-specific data identifies Mystic Flash as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate with 25 hits and 30% documented damage. The attack fires only backward. PQ20 reward listings independently identify the skill. Exact reward-slot semantics and CaC availability are retained as unresolved where sources do not directly establish them.

records.name: Evil Flight Strike
records.skill_description: An extending-arm rising Strike Super that hits repeatedly while leaving the opponent airborne.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data identifies Evil Flight Strike as a 100-Ki Strike Super for Namekian and Majin CaCs, dealing 15% damage across eight hits. Piccolo (Power Awakening) repurposes the technique as an Evasive skill using 300 stamina. PQ21 reward listings identify the quest source.

records.name: Energy Shot
records.skill_description: A chargeable Ki Blast projectile whose damage increases with charge time.
records.mechanics_notes: Skill-specific data identifies Energy Shot as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. Base use deals 3% documented damage and maximum charge deals 15%. PQ22 reward listings identify the skill. Exact reward-slot semantics are unresolved.

records.name: Death Slash
records.skill_description: A short-range sword-based Strike Super associated with Frieza's elite forces.
records.mechanics_notes: The independent PQ reward transcription places Death Slash in PQ23. The current skill guide also indexes Death Slash under PQ23. Exact resource, damage, hit-count, reward-slot and character/CaC semantics remain unresolved pending a stronger skill-specific reference.
